leastWorthwhile.text: The initial attempt was least productive because I expected the collision immediately; Theia first needed an angled trajectory.

surprise.text: The unsuccessful first pairing automatically set Theia on an oblique course, making the collision geometry an explicit step.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt entirely purposeless, though using a generic rocky body's gravity to establish the surviving Earth felt somewhat abstract.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the orbiting debris becomes the Moon and how the remelted Earth evolves.
